info.name: Sprint 11 - Comunicación OpenFeign y APIs veterinarias

exec: pm.test("Nombres Eureka exactos", () => { const apps=[].concat(pm.response.json().applications.application); for (const name of ["MS-DUENO","MS-MASCOTA","MS-VETERINARIO","MS-TURNO"]) pm.expect(apps.some(app => app.name===name && [].concat(app.instance).some(i => i.status==="UP"))).to.eql(true); });
